description: App-command grants for the `buddy-list` window: friend list management, invites, blocking, community create/join, status/presence, game launch and the installed games it lists (`get_installed_games`, the Host's `InstalledGamesGet`), opening other windows, DM list, group DMs (create, the pending invites' accept and decline, the list), strand-relay volunteering, the deep-link consent dialog, `open_external_url` for the menu bar's links, and the call shell it alone hosts (incoming-call modal, call waiting, outgoing and group panels, missed calls) plus the session-reset prompt — the app's home base. The skin tree it renders (`src/components/skin-tree/SkinTreeWindow.tsx`, plan SK2-A4) runs its nodes' actions (`run_skin_action`), reports its selection (`set_skin_selection`) and opens or closes the pack popup the Host's answer to a `LaunchPopup` names (`open_skin_popup`, plan SK2-A5); of the other windows only the pack popups (`app-skin-popup.json`) render a skin tree and hold the first two. Its Downloads view (`EngineView::Files`, plan E7.2 G12) lists, starts, stops, reveals and removes transfers (`transfer_list`, `transfer_start` with its save dialog in Rust, `transfer_stop`, `transfer_open`, `transfer_remove`); no other window holds those. `core:window:allow-start-resize-dragging` for the tree-laid window's resize edges (`src/components/skin-tree/ResizeHandle.tsx`): with the pack popups (`app-skin-popup.json`), the only windows that resize from their own edges. No plugin grants.
